result.title: Watch Your Step: Adam's Margin Maximization Bias Depends on the Learning Rate Schedule
result.summary: We study the implicit bias of Adam and its similarity to sign gradient descent on homogeneous models in binary classification tasks. Perhaps surprisingly, we uncover that these depend on the learning rate schedule. While previous works studied strongly decaying learning rate schedules $η(t)=\mathrm o \left(t^{1/L-1}\right)$, where $L$ is the homogeneity degree, and showed $\ell_\infty$-margin-maximization biases, we focus on the more common complementary regime, including constant and weakly decaying schedules. For a polynomial schedule $t^α$ and homogeneity degree $L$, we show that when $α> \frac 1L - \frac12$, Adam has no trajectory-independent margin-maximization bias for deep linear networks (in the KKT sense): first, there is no non-trivial, locally Lipschitz, convex implicit regularizer in this setting, including any squared norm. Second, on width-$1$ networks, the result holds without requiring convexity, implying that any implicit regularizer for wide networks must be trivial when restricted to a width-$1$ network. Nevertheless, we positively characterize the implicit bias in this regime as maximizing a trajectory-dependent weighted-$\ell_2$ margin for any $L$-homogeneous model. The fundamental mechanism behind our results is convergence of Adam's preconditioner to a trajectory-dependent vector, which also allows showing that the limiting parameter direction depends on initialization. In the intermediate regime $\frac 1L - 1 \leq α\leq \frac1L - \frac12$ we prove an $\ell_\infty$ bias, conditional on gradient directional convergence to a full-support vector. Of independent interest, we establish a loss decay rate for full batch Adam on general homogeneous models, whose leading order depends only on the second-moment parameter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究齐次模型二分类中 Adam 的隐式偏置，揭示其是否表现为 ℓ∞ 边际最大化取决于学习率调度：在常数或弱衰减调度下不存在轨迹无关的凸隐式正则，只能刻画为轨迹依赖的加权 ℓ2 边际最大化，机制是预条件子收敛到轨迹相关向量，极限参数方向亦依赖初始化。
AI.relevance_reason: 「轨迹依赖的隐式偏置」与初始化敏感的收敛方向，可能为思考 latent 推理轨迹训练中的贡献分配与状态几何提供分析视角，可供核查其在 VLM 推理训练上的适用性。
